stories.title: Researchers propose StereoVLM for metric 3D reasoning in vision-language models
stories.summary: A new paper proposes StereoVLM, a binocular vision-language model that uses stereo image pairs to reason about metric 3D space, addressing the ambiguity of single-image 3D inference in existing VLMs.
stories.more: Existing vision-language models can describe 3D scenes semantically but struggle with metric 3D measurements, partly because they infer scene structure from uncalibrated images without cross-view geometric constraints. The paper argues this leaves it unclear whether a model's spatial predictions reflect real visual evidence or just semantic priors. StereoVLM instead uses binocular, calibrated image pairs to provide cross-view geometric constraints for grounding 3D reasoning. The excerpt available does not specify benchmark results or model size.

stories.title: Walmart lets Meta's Muse AI agent shop for Black Friday deals
stories.summary: Walmart is rolling out Meta's Agent Gateway integration, letting the Muse AI agent search for and purchase Black Friday deals on shoppers' behalf without sharing their purchase history.
stories.more: The feature lets Meta's Muse assistant act as a shopping agent on Walmart's site, finding and buying Black Friday deals for users. It builds on the Agent Gateway that Walmart announced last month, designed to let AI agents find relevant products without accessing a shopper's purchase history. The rollout coincides with the Black Friday shopping period. Further details on availability or safeguards were not given in the available excerpt.

stories.title: Oregon and Virginia sue Musk companies over Grok deepfake images
stories.summary: Attorneys general from Oregon and Virginia filed lawsuits against several Elon Musk companies, alleging weak safeguards let Grok produce sexualized deepfake images of real people, including children.
stories.more: The lawsuits, brought by the Oregon and Virginia attorneys general, target multiple companies tied to Elon Musk over the Grok AI chatbot's image-generation capabilities. The states allege the companies failed to implement adequate safeguards to prevent Grok from producing sexualized imagery of real people, including minors. The available excerpt does not specify the legal claims, requested remedies, or which Musk-affiliated entities are named beyond SpaceX.
